title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (PC, 2003) - KOTOR Complete 4-Disc Set
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in a galaxy far, far away with this complete 4-disc set of Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic for PC. This epic game, released in 2003 by LucasArts, is a must-have for any fan of the Star Wars franchise. 

Experience the thrill of being a Jedi Knight and a member of the Ghost crew as you navigate through the game's exciting storyline. With a T-Teen rating, this game is suitable for all ages. This set includes four disks and is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure in a world filled with danger and excitement.
